[P2] Check the completed delivery failure before taking the ACK shortcut

This shortcut ignores an available nonfatal `completedFailure`. For example, a large-result checkpoint can be acknowledged, metadata pagination can fail, and the worker can enter its RETRYING End hook. Interrupting the runtime caller while that hook runs records a lifecycle failure; if End cooperatively exits, cleanup observes the original metadata failure but this branch still returns `SUCCEEDED`. Restrict the shortcut to lifecycle cutoff failures and preserve unrelated completed delivery failures. Add an executor-level regression combining terminal acknowledgment, metadata failure, and interrupted End cleanup.
